profile.headline: Software Developer at IBM
profile.summary: I graduated from University at Buffalo with a degree in Computer Science. I have been developing way before then! After graduating, I worked for M&T Bank as a full stack developer.  I worked on a critical internal application that ALL bank tellers nationwide used. While working there, I shipped the ability for tellers to perform wire transfers on the platform over $2 million. I now work for IBM specifically the z/VM product. This software allows multiple operating systems to be run under one physical machine. I also build and ship SaaS products on the side. Currently I am building 3DQuoter, a platform which helps 3D Printing operators to accept and manage custom print orders!

positions.title: Software Engineer (TDP)
positions.description:
Developed and Maintained application that allowed Wire Transfers under $2M given various constraints.

Developed library of various Javascript UI components used by various teams totaling over 40 developers.

Led an organizational effort to convert data fetching techniques to use RxJS, which led to an increase in developer output by 30%

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Reduced development time by up to 50% by automating build tasks.

Decreased maintenance and development time on various websites by creating and enforcing coding
standards, saving the company up to 50% in their budget.

Created standard coding practices that were used by a team of over 30 developers.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - CSE 220: Systems Programming
positions.description:
Led lab section of 27 students, lectured on important class topics and tools.

Increased passing rate by over 5% (compared to average pass rate) by creating additional educational content
for students.

Developed plagiarism script; to be used for future classes; that caught 5 cases of academic integrity upholding
schools core values.

positions.title: Summer "IT On Ramp" Instructor
positions.description:
Created safe classroom environments conducive to cooperative and hands-on learning.

Explained complex Computer Science topics to students in a language they can relate to and understand.

Assisted students with the successful completion of programming projects and evaluation.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Participated in the development and launch of a new website with over 10k Visitors
Updated the website with new features like an automatic FIFA bracket updater
Assisted with technical issues on the website that affected performance

projects.title: 8 Compiler
projects.description: A compiler for a niche 8-bit computer based off Ben Eater. This compiler takes specific syntax code and converts it to binary code. This binary code can be uploaded to Ben Eater's computer through a programmer like an arduino.
A C implementation of the famous 2048 game
